title: Hackers plant crypto-stealing code on 178 major websites, including HSBC and Ledger
summary: An Optimizely signup flaw let an attacker plant address-swapping code on websites including HSBC, the BBC and Ledger. The total stolen remains unknown, and investigators have not linked the attack to AI.

title: Binance hacker moves $63 million in stolen ether after 2 weeks of silence
summary: North Korea's TraderTraitor group transferred 34,279 ETH to three new wallets. The funds have not moved again, blockchain investigators say.

title: Lighter suspends all withdrawals after $10.4 million crypto exploit
summary: The decentralized exchange blamed a leaked trading API key and said its smart contracts were unaffected, while investigators traced funds to Hyperliquid.

title: Brazil's central bank faces backlash over stablecoin money laundering remarks
summary: A central bank official reportedly said legitimate funds become tainted when moved into stablecoins, comparing the market to the informal "dólar-cabo" system.

title: German parliament proposes crypto seizures without criminal charges
summary: German lawyers said a proposed law allowing the seizure of assets worth more than 100,000 euros could impose a burden of proof on crypto holders rather than the authorities.

title: Bitcoin slips after rebounding from July 14 low that triggered $2 billion of liquidations
summary: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.6% since midnight UTC at around $64,300, after falling to $62,100 on Sunday, its lowest since July 14, as traders await Nvidia earnings.

title: Google says hackers use AI agents to find and exploit software flaws
summary: Google says attackers are using AI agents to find and exploit software flaws automatically, reducing the time organizations have to apply patches.

title: Trezor customer data exposed in 3rd partner breach this year
summary: Trezor warned an attacker has been able to access customer names, phone numbers and delivery addresses linked to 27,000 orders from one of its shipping providers.

title: Hackers inject credit card, crypto-stealing malware into 178 major websites
summary: Ledger and Coinpass were among the businesses whose websites served malware designed to steal visitors’ crypto and credit card details, according to security researchers.

title: Binance hack may push institutions to outside custody, FalconX exec says
summary: FalconX’s Joshua Lim says the Binance hack could push institutions to keep crypto off exchanges and change how large investors trade in 2027.

title: Lighter recovers $5M after $10M exploit linked to compromised API keys
summary: Lighter restored withdrawals after recovering approximately $5 million in USDC, while blockchain analysts traced $10.4 million in funds moved during the exploit.

title: Aster CEO suspects foul play after token plunges 32% in minutes
summary: Aster’s CEO attributed the extreme volatility to highly leveraged liquidations but said the exchange remained operational.

title: Peraire-Bueno brothers acquitted of wire fraud in $25 million Ethereum MEV case
summary: A judge acquitted the Peraire-Bueno brothers of wire fraud over the Ethereum MEV exploit, ruling prosecutors showed no misrepresentation.

title: Solflare CEO says AI security reviews are essential, touts ‘bunker mode’ and MoneyGram deal
summary: Vidor Gencel says AI catches chained exploits humans miss, and details the wallet's "bunker mode," privacy mode, and MoneyGram USDC cash-out.

title: US senators seek SEC answers on tokenized stock money laundering risks
summary: Four Democratic senators asked who would be responsible for tokenized shares transferred outside regulated platforms and whether the SEC could freeze or recover those tokens.

title: Fed’s Waller cites Binance hack in warning over tokenized finance
summary: Fed Governor Christopher Waller questioned who bears responsibility for fraud, compromised keys and failed transactions as traditional financial assets move onto blockchains.

title: Google finds self-running AI hacking tool with Russian comments in its files
summary: Google spots an AI that can find and exploit software flaws on its own, no human needed.

title: Crypto Long & Short: Crypto exchanges shouldn’t double as the vault
summary: A single breach moved billions out of Binance in minutes, exposing how much client money sits with the venue that trades it. Darren Jordan of Komainu argues institutions should keep trading and custody separate, as traditional markets have for decades, and sets out the questions to ask about where assets are held.

title: Binance obtains $6.5 billion freezing order from Abu Dhabi court in bid to recover stolen crypto
summary: Binance has obtained a $6.5 billion worldwide freezing order from the Abu Dhabi Global Market Courts as it seeks to recover crypto stolen in October hack.

title: Binance says it obtained $6.5B worldwide freezing order after hack
summary: The court orders allow legal notices to be served via blockchain and provide for a continuously updated list of 26,000 wallet addresses linked to stolen assets, Binance’s lawyers said.

title: Ledger expands hardware hack investigation to Germany, UAE as new cases emerge
summary: The company confirmed that the new cases share the same kind of physical modification as tampered devices found across Southeast Asia.

title: Ethereum block builders received the most in a $3.4 million vault hack, data shows
summary: An automated trading bot copied the attack on K3 Capital's sBOLD vault, taking more than half the funds and paying most of its proceeds to get its transactions processed first.

title: Binance hackers stole 192 tokens across 11 networks, court docs show
summary: Stablecoins accounted for at least $3.46 billion of the $6.3 billion stolen, while the hackers also took memecoins, tokenized gold and gaming tokens.

title: North Korean hackers used Sky's stablecoin system, putting billions at freeze risk
summary: Blockchain investigation traced $518 million in illicit-linked activity, including the 2025 Bybit hack, through a key reserve backing DAI and USDS tokens, putting Sky's institutional finance ambitions and open design on collision course.

title: Binance wins $6.5 billion feezing order against hackers behind crypto's largest theft
summary: The crypto exchange said it has already replaced the stolen assets using its own funds and insurance reserves.

title: Binance’s $6.5B freeze order, Hong Kong ‘suspicious’ of HYPE: Asia Express
summary: Binance obtains court orders freezing assets stolen in October’s hack. Hong Kong warns citizens about Hyperliquid, and Thai police arrest four foreigners linked to a crypto scam.

title: SEC charges eight firms over fake crypto platforms tied to $37M fraud
summary: Fraudsters allegedly used social media ads, chat groups and forged SEC filings to defraud US investors of approximately $37 million.
